name: Case Paradise
desc:
📦 Welcome to Case Paradise! 📦

🎉 The ultimate case opening experience! Step inside and open a variety of cases filled with unique and rare weapon skins. Build your collection by unboxing incredible items, then test your luck by battling other players in exciting case battle modes.

👉 Updates every Saturday!

👍Like and favorite the game for good luck!🤭

⚠️ Note: This game is a simulation. No real money or outside items are involved.

⭐Credits to Valve for all the items!
